title: 2017 USAMO Problem 5
statement: Let \(\mathbf{Z}\) denote the set of all integers. Find all real numbers \(c > 0\) such that there exists a labeling of the lattice points \(( x, y ) \in \mathbf{Z}^2\) with positive integers for which: only finitely many distinct labels occur, and for each label \(i\), the distance between any two points labeled \(i\) is at least \(c^i\).
